findings.highlight: it finally hits me that I can sleep now.
findings.evidenceJa: ようやく帰ってきた、という実感
findings.governingReading: 帰ってきたという実感 is the felt reality of returning home after the day.
findings.explanation: Finally feeling home becomes realizing he can sleep.

findings.evidenceJa: 先輩と一緒に帰ってるときでも
findings.governingReading: 一緒に帰ってるときでも concerns their walk home; scene29 separately preserves continuous hand contact.
findings.explanation: The hand's warmth during their return becomes warmth after reaching home.

findings.evidenceJa: 手足は逆に血の気を失っている
findings.governingReading: 血の気を失っている describes pallor/lack of circulating warmth, not blood exiting the limbs; the actual bleeding occurs later from his finger.
findings.explanation: Blood draining from cold extremities becomes the limbs losing blood.

findings.highlight: It won't be good for you.
findings.evidenceJa: 先輩が好きでも、先輩のためになれない
findings.governingReading: 先輩が好きでも openly concedes she likes/loves him before he asks her family-versus-girl question.
findings.explanation: Sakura's explicit affection is missing before her concern that it cannot benefit him.

findings.evidenceJa: その弱々しさに息を飲む
findings.governingReading: 弱々しさ/声が弱っている register fading strength under high fever, prompting alarm and plans for help.
findings.explanation: Worsening bodily weakness becomes tenderness and meekness.

findings.evidenceJa: 血が滲むほど俺を握りしめる
findings.governingReading: 血が滲むほど states the concrete intensity of the grip amid her distress.
findings.explanation: Squeezing hard enough to draw blood loses the bleeding.

findings.highlight: All I recall is how unsettlingly good it felt.
findings.evidenceJa: 思い出すことも億劫なほどに気持ちが良い
findings.governingReading: 思い出すことも億劫なほどに気持ちが良い explains why he does not try to recall; it is current sensation.
findings.explanation: Present pleasure making recollection too much effort becomes a remembered pleasure from the earlier episode.

findings.highlight: at least as much as a blood donation.
findings.evidenceJa: 献血程度の損血だろう
findings.governingReading: 程度だろう estimates roughly that much; no at least is given.
findings.explanation: An estimated blood-donation-sized loss becomes a lower bound.

findings.highlight: this grotesque body that always craves magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力が足りないとおかしくなる身体
findings.governingReading: 魔力が足りないとおかしくなる gives a deficiency condition and abnormal reaction, not constant craving or a description of bodily appearance as grotesque.
findings.explanation: Malfunction when energy is insufficient becomes a grotesque body that always craves energy.

findings.highlight: When I want power as a mage, the worms in my body start to twinge.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の力が欲しくて、身体の虫たちが疼き出す
findings.governingReading: 身体の虫たちが is the subject of 欲しくて and 疼き出す; the next sentence explicitly reiterates the worms' hunger.
findings.explanation: The worms craving a mage's power becomes Sakura wanting power as a mage.

findings.highlight: it hammers home how heavy the burden is.
findings.evidenceJa: 今はそれだけで魔力を消費するものになっている
findings.governingReading: 今はそれだけで魔力を消費する changes what daily life costs after her return to Master status.
findings.explanation: Ordinary existence itself now consuming energy disappears into a generic heavy burden.

findings.highlight: who only feels good when she drinks your blood
findings.evidenceJa: 血を吸って楽になることしか考えない
findings.governingReading: 楽になることしか考えない is her self-accusation of obsessive thought, not an exclusive physiological pleasure mechanism.
findings.explanation: Thinking only about relief through blood becomes only being able to feel good when drinking blood.

findings.highlight: if you hated me for the one thing I can do to help you.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にしてやれる唯一のことを嫌がられたら
findings.governingReading: してやれる唯一のことを嫌がられたら is aversion to the offered act itself.
findings.explanation: Refusing the one help he can give becomes hating him for that help.

findings.highlight: feel free to drink it anytime.
findings.evidenceJa: いつでも言ってくれていい
findings.governingReading: いつでも言ってくれていい explicitly invites communication, followed by her asking again and his agreement.
findings.explanation: An invitation to ask for blood becomes blanket permission to drink anytime.

findings.highlight: It was an unavoidable ordeal for Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は退っ引きならないほど深刻なのに
findings.governingReading: 退っ引きならないほど深刻なのに describes her still inescapably serious condition despite his warm recollection.
findings.explanation: Sakura's ongoing grave predicament becomes a finished unavoidable ordeal.

findings.highlight: I shouldn't be able to get up
findings.governingReading: 起きている筈はない is a state-of-consciousness premise proving the proximity must be a dream, not a claim of immobility.
findings.explanation: Cannot be awake becomes unable to get up.

findings.evidenceJa: どちらも壊れてしまうぐらい
findings.governingReading: どちらも壊れてしまう makes the destructive fantasy mutual.
findings.explanation: Both of them breaking becomes one of them breaking.

findings.evidenceJa: どちらもカタルシスには違いない
findings.governingReading: どちらも refers to the two processes in the immediately preceding sentence, not Shirou and Sakura.
findings.explanation: Both creation and collapse being catharsis becomes catharsis for both participants.

findings.highlight: it became something I don't quite understand.
findings.evidenceJa: よく分からない何かに食いつかれ
findings.governingReading: 何かに食いつかれ retains a concrete hostile action during the dream's turn to menace.
findings.explanation: An unknown thing biting into him becomes an unspecified change into something unknown.
